info.name: PHED — Pay Period Lifecycle (Full Flow + Revert)
info.description:
Complete request collection for the PHED pay period lifecycle: creation → validation → template → upload → compute → approve, plus the new REVERT endpoint that rolls any step back.

## Quick start
1. Set `baseUrl` and `companyId` in collection variables.
2. Set `token` to an HR/Admin JWT (use `POST /api/auth/login` with hr@company.com / 0001A).
3. Run the **Happy Path** folder top-to-bottom — `periodId` is captured automatically by the Create request.
4. Use **Revert** at any point to roll back one step, then re-run the next step forward.

## Status flow
DRAFT → VALIDATION_OPEN → VALIDATION_CLOSED → TEMPLATE_ISSUED → PROCESSING → REVIEW → APPROVED → PAID

## Approval memo trigger
The Module 12 approval memo (Manager Comp & Benefits → ... → MD/CEO) is submitted when the period reaches **REVIEW** status — not APPROVED. See the companion collection `PHED_Postman_Collection_Payroll_Approval_and_Access_Matrix.json` for the approval workflow.

## Revert rules
- Rolls back exactly one step at a time.
- DRAFT and PAID cannot be reverted.
- Blocked (409) if an active approval memo exists on the period (flag the memo first).
- Data is never deleted by revert — uploaded salary inputs and computed results persist and are overwritten when the step is re-run.

request.description:
Downloads the HR-editable Excel salary template. Use 'Send and Download' in Postman to save the file.

## Template structure
- **Grey / locked:** S/N, Employee ID, Name, Role, Grade, Level
- **Yellow / editable (pre-populated):** one column per active cooperative (pre-filled from stored monthly deduction amounts) + one column per active deduction liability
- **Yellow / editable (start at 0):** Basic Salary, all allowances, Voluntary Pension, Insurance, Cash Advanced, Loan, Domestic Loan

## NOT in the template
- **Union deductions** — computed automatically by the engine at /compute as `grossSalary × union.percentage`. Never HR-entered.
- **Overtime** — managed separately via POST /pay-periods/:id/overtime.

Call after step 4a has advanced the period to TEMPLATE_ISSUED. Update cooperative amounts first via PUT /staff/:id/cooperatives if needed — they will then be pre-filled here.

response.name: 200 OK — binary Excel
response.body: <binary Excel data>

request.description:
Uploads the filled HR payroll template (multipart/form-data, field name: 'file').

What the upload reads per staff row:
- All salary/allowance columns by header name
- Each cooperative column (by cooperative name) — summed into a single cooperativeDeductions value
- Each deduction liability column — summed into deductionLiabilities
- Does NOT read union deductions (not in template — computed by engine)

Engine-computed fields (gross, PAYE, pension, net, union deductions) are reset to 0 and recalculated fresh by /compute. Cooperative and deduction-liability amounts are stored and survive re-compute.

Also allowed from REVIEW for re-upload without reverting (salary inputs are overwritten; re-compute required after).

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
Runs the full payroll engine (PAYE, pension, NSITF, ITF, NHF, deductions) for all active staff. Also allowed from REVIEW for re-compute without reverting.

Union deductions: computed as grossSalary × sum(union.percentage) where percentage is a decimal fraction (e.g. 0.025 = 2.5%). No manual entry required.

Overtime: computed as (grossBeforeOT ÷ 160) × 1.5 × overtimeHours if an PhedOvertimeEntry exists for the staff member.

After this step the Manager Comp & Benefits can submit the approval memo (see companion collection).

response.name: 200 OK — period now in REVIEW
400 — No salary data uploaded yet

request.description: HR's internal sign-off on the pay period. Note: the approval memo chain (Module 12) starts at REVIEW — before this step.

response.name: 200 OK

item.name: Revert — Roll Back One Step
item.description: POST to /revert to roll the pay period back one step at a time. Can be called repeatedly. Blocked (409) if an active approval memo exists — flag the memo first, then retry.

request.description:
Rolls the period back one step. The revert map:

- VALIDATION_OPEN → DRAFT (clears validationOpenAt)
- VALIDATION_CLOSED → VALIDATION_OPEN (clears validationCloseAt)
- TEMPLATE_ISSUED → VALIDATION_CLOSED
- PROCESSING → TEMPLATE_ISSUED
- REVIEW → PROCESSING
- APPROVED → REVIEW (clears approvedBy, approvedAt)

Data is never deleted — uploaded salary inputs and computed results persist and are overwritten when the step is re-run. Call repeatedly to go back multiple steps.

response.name: 200 OK — reverted PROCESSING → TEMPLATE_ISSUED

item.name: Correction Scenarios
item.description: Common correction flows combining revert + redo.

item.name: Scenario A — Re-open validation (HR closed it too early)

request.description:
Period must currently be VALIDATION_CLOSED.

Step 1: Call revert → reverts to VALIDATION_OPEN (clears validationCloseAt).
Step 2: Staff continue validating.
Step 3: Call close-validation again when ready.

Use the same revert request body — no body required.

response.name: 200 OK — VALIDATION_CLOSED → VALIDATION_OPEN

item.name: Scenario B — Re-upload template (HR uploaded wrong file)

request.description:
Period must currently be PROCESSING.

Step 1: Call revert → reverts to TEMPLATE_ISSUED.
Step 2: Call upload-template with the correct file → back to PROCESSING.
Step 3: Call compute.

Alternative (if already in REVIEW): just re-upload directly from REVIEW — upload-template allows it without reverting.

response.name: 200 OK — PROCESSING → TEMPLATE_ISSUED

item.name: Scenario C — Fix salary data in REVIEW (no revert needed)

request.description:
Period is in REVIEW. HR spots a salary error.

No revert needed — upload-template accepts REVIEW status directly.

Step 1: Re-upload corrected template (this request).
Step 2: Re-run compute → results overwritten.

Note: if an approval memo is already in progress at REVIEW, the memo must be flagged first (which sets memo to RETURNED_FOR_CORRECTION) before re-uploading.

response.name: 200 OK — re-uploaded from REVIEW

item.name: Cooperative Deduction Management
item.description:
Manage per-staff cooperative monthly deduction amounts. These amounts are pre-filled into the payroll template yellow cooperative columns. Update them before downloading the template to ensure the correct amounts appear.

Set {{staffId}} to the PhedStaff id (not the human-readable staffId code).

item.name: GET Staff Cooperatives — view current amounts

request.description: Lists all cooperative memberships for a staff member, including their stored monthly deduction amount (totalAmount).

response.name: 200 OK

item.name: POST — Add Staff to Cooperative (with monthly amount)

request.description: Adds a staff member to a cooperative with a monthly deduction amount. Returns 409 if the staff member is already a member of this cooperative (use PUT to update amount instead).

response.name: 201 Created

request.description:
Updates the monthly deduction amount for an existing cooperative membership. Returns 404 if the staff member is not a member of this cooperative (use POST first).

After updating, re-download the payroll template — the new amount will appear pre-filled in the cooperative column for this staff member.

response.name: 200 OK
404 — Not a member of this cooperative
